question: Using the sales data, what is the median value of total sales made in countries where the number of customers is greater than 4?
sql:
SELECT MEDIAN(Total) as median_total
FROM invoices i
JOIN customers c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
WHERE c.Country IN (
    SELECT Country
    FROM customers
    GROUP BY Country
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 4
)

WITH countries_with_many_customers AS (
    SELECT Country
    FROM customers
    GROUP BY Country
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 4
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY Total) as median_total
FROM invoices i
JOIN customers c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
